entry1.paragraph:
Your data is safe with us. All your information is stored exclusively locally on your phone in an SQLite database and protected with strong 256‑bit AES encryption. This ensures that only you have access to it. We place great emphasis on privacy and deliberately avoid storing or sharing your data on external servers.

If you use the email service, your email address, password, and mail server are also protected with the same strong encryption before processing. Your sensitive information remains as protected as possible at all times. Your privacy is our top priority – you retain full control over your data.

entry2.subheading: How does the email server work?
entry2.paragraph:
With our email service you can send your application folder directly to the email address of your desired company – you only need the appropriate contact address. The subject line and a template for the email text are generated automatically, making the sending quick and straightforward.

Your data is transferred to our server with secure 2048‑bit encryption, where the application folder is decrypted and forwarded directly to the recipient. No logs are created and data is not stored permanently – the information stays only temporarily in the cache and is deleted immediately after forwarding.

We are already working on a fully local version of this service, so you will have even more control over your data in the future. The service is completely free and optional – you decide whether to use it.

entry3.paragraph: You can either create a brand‑new cover letter or reuse an existing one. For about 1 cent per generation you can get a cover letter tailored to the desired position. Alternatively, you can reuse an earlier cover letter, adjust it by selecting the company, redefining the contact person, and editing the text as you wish. This saves time while keeping you flexible to adapt each application as needed.
